title: 直臂小停顿
description: 平涂赛璐璐风格中，低位攀爬者用直臂与大脚点自然停顿。

art_direction.medium: colored pencil sports sketch with layered visible pencil marks
art_direction.scene: Create an original clean cel-shaded illustration of a fictional adult pausing comfortably on large low holds. An orange vertical route contains two oversized hand jugs and wide flat foot ledges, allowing the climber to stand through the legs with one arm nearly straight. The body remains close to a pale blue wall and no higher than a modest step above the thick crash mat. Use a frontal wide shot so both supporting feet and the clear landing zone remain visible. Add simple overhead lights and geometric gym volumes in the background. The figure wears opaque everyday climbing clothes. Keep the composition wordless, calm, and free of brands.
